mechanism: Atazanavir (CYP3A4 inhibitor) may increase lisdexamfetamine metabolism via dexedrine active metabolite, and amphetamines may increase cardiovascular stress; additionally, both drugs have potential CNS effects.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and psychiatric symptoms closely; consider alternative antiretroviral if cardiovascular risk factors present; avoid dose escalation of lisdexamfetamine.
